title: The normalized comparison for a Koszul-regular quotient is invertible
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, n,r natural numbers, and f:Fin r -> A a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence] with span(range f)=I. Then the unique normalized map selfTorConormalComparison A I n [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison] from the nth exterior conormal module to Tor_n^A(A/I,A/I) is an isomorphism of A-modules, including n=0, r=0, and I=A.

source.place: lemma-divided-powers-on-tor; Tags 062I and 06YH for conormal and derived tensor

proof.text: Use the Koszul projective resolution of A/I. Tensor with A/I, so every differential coefficient vanishes and homology is the degree-n term.
Use the conormal basis indexed by f. Its nth exterior basis corresponds to the increasing Koszul wedges in the tensor resolution.

The defining normalization of the canonical map sends each of these wedges to that Koszul homology class. It is the composite of the exterior basis, zero-differential homology, and resolution Tor isomorphisms.
